setup.sourceRule: Expected initial empty target only. Buffer listener observations while enabling, including events delivered before the enable Promise resolves. Fail unaccounted setup evidence or measured traffic.

observedHelpers.indexRule: Keep original parsed event whether binding succeeds or fails. Allow only narrowly named operations in a capture; same untrusted world + generic constant code is never sufficient. Full-ledger one-to-one reassessment; source-locked wrapper bytes obtained from pinned implementation. Never hide competing app parse.

proposedFields.pwRawTerminal: request alias, callback ordinal, requestfinished|requestfailed, exact allowlisted error class and source presence; no waiting for redirectedTo
proposedFields.cdpRawTerminal: actual callback type, errorText presence/value class, blockedReason presence/value, canceled=true|false|unreported|not-applicable; keep actual terminal ordinals
proposedFields.cdpResponseCache: each disk/prefetch/service-worker field true|false|unreported; explicit requestServedFromCache and worker/interception incidents retained

proposedFields.responseCookie: response-bearing PW request only; pair original request and actual response object/redirect via lifetime joins

network.indexRule: Strictly retain direct webpack identities and v3 HMR retirement. Optional evidence only proves supported origin-delivery route in combination with a unique actual guard exchange. An exceptional absent canceled bit never maps to false.

proposedFields.proxyResponse,responseExtra: setRole/downRole where relevant = none|delete-root|tenant|unsupported; original, forwarded, CDP raw projections; explicit scope/attribute outcome; SID set separately; env/challenge cleanup classified from pinned independent code
proposedFields.proxyOpen: actual incoming/forwarded UA commitment in addition to cookie commitment; raw UA and private SHA256(SID) held only in ephemeral exchange object, never in public journal
proposedFields.session: actual observed nullable org/env fields (absent|expected) and lease/role; references to issuance and authenticated landing request, matched PW/CDP/guard, verifier and private envelope row
proposedFields.privateEnvelope: {verifierLedger,contexts:[{contextId,mode,proxyTokenHash,userAgent,cookieScope,verification} x6]}; use recovery v2 exact types; actual verifier ledger; no persisted values

cookieAndRecovery.guardDelta: Private HTTP request projections add user-agent only and independent pre-forward callback; preserve all guard4 HMR ownership/FIN/close accounting and private header suppression.

proposedEvents.initialNodeObservation: document-bound source ordinal/structural path, node kind, relevant attributes commitment, mutation order, subtree position, oldValue and stable node alias when present; no raw source in public artifact
proposedEvents.policyCoverage: pre-navigation subscriptions and guard pre-write source ordinal; linked actual response/early document binding, definitive no-policy result only after original source and complete observed interval
proposedEvents.declaration: kind=script|preload|both; ordered source node refs, DOM observation refs, full URL and document commitments; digest includes kind and source attributes/multiplicity
proposedEvents.endRenderWithoutCandidate: strict zero only; validated observation freeze, context/document/frame/loader, before witness, actual HTML/inventory/cut reference and post-stat; no invented URL, token, declaration or execution

htmlAndMap.indexRule: resolveDocumentRequests uses same full lifetime graph on partial network ledger solely for object selection, independent of pending bodies. Recompute at cut/drain with all additional candidates. Zero map terminal cannot certify an exceptional scope.

goldenAndAdversarialControls: Drive the real public install/attach/create/navigate/click/verify/cut/close/drain path with raw independent emitters. No test hook emits sanitized index rows or accepts a branded-success boolean.
Runtime existing about:blank worlds before ack and debugger replay; reject unknown target, missing ack, pre-ready network and post-retirement late setup row.
Exact csp versus net::ERR_NOT_CSP_RELATED, mixed case, missing and aborted. Explicit false versus absent canceled. Unknown remains raw and red.
Native response-less script produces exactly raw PW/CDP failures, zero Cookie/proxy/body; add contradictory transmitted exchange and reject.

Clean POST Fetch returns 303, no Location/child, real finished. Actual historical-shape POST and GET failed callbacks remain fatal even with successful sibling. Native Document chain still has actual redirect callback triples.

Owned helper actual compile ID/exact PW-source challenge and generation; spoofed sourceURL, same bytes wrong world, shared default constant, reentrant duplicate and delayed replay all unavailable. Ordinary app parse during fence invalidates it.

Initial script and matching script preload observed against original ordered source; mutation add/remove/reinsert, attribute transient http-equiv/nonce/integrity change, new base and effective CSP meta are never ignored. Missing earliest observer fails.

Observed initial role tombstone with current SID issuance then outgoing absent then tenant role set; reject wrong scope, SID deletion, duplicate protected cookie, foreign org/lease and expired env mistaken for portal role.

Native and enhanced declaration kind differs despite same bytes; reject. Correct script/preload/both; shared URLs in two loaders select distinct PW response objects. A truly empty strict pair closes map with two no-candidate terminals.

Repeated equal-cookie 307s use positive guard pre-forward exclusion only where logically impossible; all relevant ExtraInfo delivered late leaves two assignments red. Never use ConnectTiming to assign redirect hops.
Missing cache fields with fully matched observed origin delivery and no bypass indicators versus absent/ambiguous guard exchange or positive cache/worker flag. Never manufacture raw false.

Derive private guard token hash from matched outgoing landing cookie and compare actual POST/landing UA, scope and signed readback. Missing wire UA, fresh jar after wrong outgoing cookie and wrong exchange all quarantine. Inspect public output for sentinel values.

Actual CDPSession.close plus physical context close and planned HMR retirement; wrong event spelling, missing CDP close, pre-issue socket close, one-sided FIN or late error rejects. All fifty v3 index assertions retained.
